payload.title: [TICKET-007] Polish Hermes reset email with shared email template conventions
payload.body:
## Summary

Refactor the Resend email content from TICKET-003 to use `@workspace/email-templates` (or project-standard React Email patterns) so Hermes admin reset mail matches dashboard branding and shared transactional email quality.

## Scope

- In scope: HTML + plaintext parts; consistent header/footer with other internal emails if applicable; no change to token semantics or links.
- Out of scope: New product copy beyond template structure; SMS.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reset email is built from shared email template package or documented convention per REQ-008.
- [ ] Rendering is covered by a unit or snapshot test if that is the pattern for other templates in the repo.
- [ ] Link and subject remain functional; manual or staging smoke send documented if required.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: TICKET-003
- Blocks: none

## Notes

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/hermes-admin-self-service-password-reset.prd.md
Defer if P0 launch is time-critical; backlog-friendly.
